drafts.text:
Every good day on a trailing account moves the floor up behind me. I know that going in.
Then I keep the same size on like the floor never moved and one red trade catches me mid-stride.
It's not the market that gets me at that point. It's forgetting the ground shifted right after a win.
Anyone else trade tomorrow's size like it's still sitting on yesterday's floor?
drafts.source: @AxelrodCoach reply on the 19 sep 'Made it to Miami' post: 'every good day moves the floor up behind you, so rushing the payout pushes the floor at you while you are still holding risk.' Plus Jesus's own real reply: 'Good day raises the floor, I keep size on, trailing eats me.'
drafts.why: The freshest real mechanism of the window, on the account's historically strongest format, and directly on-theme with the $6K Challenge series Jesus just opened around trailing drawdown.
drafts.why_es: El mecanismo real más fresco de la ventana, en el formato históricamente más fuerte de la cuenta, y directamente conectado con la serie del $6K Challenge que Jesus acaba de abrir sobre trailing drawdown.

drafts.text:
Somebody wished me well after a rough week.
I replied, still here is enough for today.
Didn't fully believe it when I typed it.
Some days the only thing I did right was not quit before the close.
No green candle. No payout. Just still standing at 4pm instead of gone by 10am.
Still here is enough for today. Some weeks that's the whole report.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply (27 likes) to a well-wisher on the 11 sep 'nobody knows what I carry' post - the account's oldest open backlog item, flagged as a prime candidate twice now.
drafts.why: A real self-quote that's sat unused since it was first flagged in cycle #10. Matches the proven pattern of real Jesus quotes beating invented lines.
drafts.why_es: Una autocita real que llevaba sin usarse desde que se marcó por primera vez en el ciclo #10. Sigue el patrón probado de que las citas reales de Jesus le ganan a las líneas inventadas.

drafts.text:
The chart doesn't know how close I am to a payout. I do.
When the setup isn't quite there, I fill in the rest myself and call it confirmation.
That's not reading price anymore. That's reading how bad I want to be done for the day.
drafts.source: Niche scan, @RealizedTrader (127 likes): 'a chart is empty on the right hand side and your brain will not leave it empty, it fills that space with what you already want.' Mechanism only, reworked for a funded-account context.
drafts.why: Keeps the mandatory aphorism slot in rotation with a genuinely new mechanism (projection bias) instead of rehashing eval-vs-funded or willpower, both already mined hard on this account.
